releases.synopsis: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

releases.title: #I'm Looking for Zombie
releases.synopsis: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

releases.title: PSYREN
releases.synopsis: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.

releases.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me
releases.synopsis: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

releases.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home
releases.synopsis: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

releases.title: Hanuman Ansh
releases.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

releases.title: The Last First: Winter K2
releases.synopsis: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

releases.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
releases.synopsis: When office worker Akira Yagami gives his life saving a child, he awakens in another world as a weak goblin. But luckily, he’s granted a unique skill that extends his lifespan decades beyond their species limit and allows him to inherit the abilities of fallen goblins. In a realm of powerful races like demons and elves, Akira’s rise to becoming the strongest goblin begins.

releases.title: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
releases.synopsis: ‪Glimpse the drama unfolding across Camp Rock.‬

releases.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!
releases.synopsis: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

releases.title: Battle Spirits [Re] ZEKKAI NO KU
releases.synopsis: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu's journey—and sets history in motion.

releases.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
releases.synopsis: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There’s only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

releases.title: The World's Strongest Witch
releases.synopsis: Cast out by her aristocratic family after manifesting a seemingly useless skill, Lorna discovers her ability, “Internet,” is an SSS-rank cheat that grants her access to the entirety of the world’s knowledge. All Lorna wants is a peaceful life, but as she collects rare gear and potent items, the “world’s weakest witch” suddenly becomes very powerful, landing in one chaotic adventure after another.

releases.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
releases.synopsis: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

releases.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
releases.synopsis: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

releases.title: Nickels
releases.synopsis: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

releases.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
releases.synopsis: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

releases.title: From Far Away
releases.synopsis: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

releases.title: Almari
releases.synopsis: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

releases.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
releases.synopsis: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

releases.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
releases.synopsis: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

releases.title: Prem Keetanu
releases.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

releases.title: Thella Kaagitham
releases.synopsis: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

releases.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
releases.synopsis: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

releases.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
releases.synopsis: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

releases.title: Sigma
releases.synopsis: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

releases.title: Anbil Avan
releases.synopsis: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

releases.title: The Pastor Who Preys
releases.synopsis: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

releases.title: Avaraachan & Sons
releases.synopsis: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

releases.title: Impure
releases.synopsis: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

releases.title: Bail
releases.synopsis: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

releases.title: Debipokkho
releases.synopsis: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

releases.title: Sweet Deceit
releases.synopsis: Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.

releases.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
releases.synopsis: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

releases.title: Gloria
releases.synopsis: A short film that captures a life-changing dilemma for a Mexican-American bride standing on the brink of traditional expectations. As Gloria prepares to marry her fiancé, Rodrigo, she is consumed by her secret, forbidden love for Emilia—a graceful, queer white woman who refuses to remain hidden in the shadows of heteronormativity. Through flashbacks to the night before the wedding, the film reveals the intense passion and friction between the two women. After an ultimatum from Emilia and a tense discovery by Gloria's sister, Sophia, the reality of their secret shatters the veil of the wedding festivities. Back in the present, Gloria faces a stark ultimatum: if she proceeds with the wedding, Emilia will leave to pursue a life of authenticity and freedom, fleeing the concealment of their relationship. As Rodrigo unknowingly waits at the altar, Gloria is left with the ultimate, breathless choice—honor her cultural tradition, or risk everything to follow a path of true self-discovery.

releases.title: Shabara
releases.synopsis: An adventure written in the stars and across time.

releases.title: Pinaka
releases.synopsis: Pinaka (2026), Action Drama Fantasy Period Thriller in Kannada language

releases.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
releases.synopsis: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

releases.title: Aali Mothi Shahani
releases.synopsis: a young girl who makes an innocent wish to Lord Ganesha to grow up into an adult so she can make her own choices and do whatever she desires.

releases.title: Anakapalli
releases.synopsis: In rural Anakapalli, a young man enters the criminal underworld under a feared gangster. When love arrives, he faces a choice between power, loyalty, and his former dreams in this tale of action and destiny.

releases.title: Disney+ Insider: Worlds Collide Concert Tour
releases.synopsis: Descendants. Zombies. And now, Camp Rock. Three fan-favorite worlds are finally colliding on one stage. Go behind the scenes of the "Worlds Collide Concert Tour" with hosts Trevor Tordjman and Jordan Clark as they get insider access hours before the doors open — seeing an empty venue transform into an all-new arena spectacular.

releases.title: Izhakalkkappuram
releases.synopsis: In an ancestral home, Dr. Ananth Sivan, an ageing Gandhian scholar, holds firmly to his lifelong beliefs, while his filmmaker daughter Karthi begins to question his convictions. Through their everyday interactions, their relationship unfolds as they navigate the delicate space between ideals, belief, and empathy.

releases.title: Obsession
releases.synopsis: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

releases.title: Matchbox the Movie
releases.synopsis: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

releases.title: Animals
releases.synopsis: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.synopsis: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

releases.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
releases.synopsis: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

releases.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
releases.synopsis: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.

releases.title: Take Charge of My Heart
releases.synopsis: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

releases.title: The Social Reckoning
releases.synopsis: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

releases.title: Fjord
releases.synopsis: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

releases.title: VisionQuest
releases.synopsis: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

releases.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
releases.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

releases.title: Eyes
releases.synopsis: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

releases.title: Angel and the Badman
releases.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

releases.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
releases.synopsis: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

releases.title: The Florist
releases.synopsis: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

releases.title: V/H/S/Mixtape
releases.synopsis: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

releases.title: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
releases.synopsis: Noa visits her boyfriend in Argentina, where she meets Tomy. As she explores her musical identity under parental pressure, Tomy tries to leave his musical past behind while both navigate life in Buenos Aires.

releases.title: Jailer 2
releases.synopsis: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

releases.title: Monster Mia
releases.synopsis: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

releases.title: Epic - First Semester
releases.synopsis: Far from home, Aditya wrestles with family expectations, cultural differences and loneliness while studying in London – until he meets the lively Kadali.

releases.title: Crystal Lake
releases.synopsis: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

releases.title: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
releases.synopsis: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

releases.title: Under Wraps
releases.synopsis: A comedy-adventure in which three twelve-year-olds have a close encounter with a 3,000-year-old mummy. Marshall, Gilbert and Amy accidentally set the mummy free, but if they don't get him back to his resting place by midnight on Halloween, he'll turn into dust and lose his only chance of being reunited with his long-lost love.

releases.title: Reporting Live
releases.synopsis: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

releases.title: Matloub Aaeleyan
releases.synopsis: Farouk, a supermarket manager, is so consumed by his work that he has little time for his wife, Mai, and their children. His unemployed brother-in-law, Galal, comes to live with the family and completely turns Farouk's life upside down, dragging him into a series of hilarious troubles and impossible situations.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.synopsis: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

releases.title: Fresh Meat
releases.synopsis: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

releases.title: Comrade Kalyan
releases.synopsis: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

releases.title: Tenzing
releases.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

releases.title: Hollywood Arts
releases.synopsis: Struggling actress Trina Vega returns to her former high school, Hollywood Arts, as an unqualified substitute teacher, quickly finding herself both clashing with and unexpectedly inspiring a new generation of ambitious and talented students as they learn to find their true path at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.

releases.title: Love of Your Life
releases.synopsis: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

releases.title: Gondhal
releases.synopsis: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

releases.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
releases.synopsis: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

releases.title: The Storm
releases.synopsis: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be trapped together. Their polished acts fall, and an unfiltered meltdown starts. When the panic starts to creep in and they all realise the seriousness of the situation, the farm starts to shrink, secrets spill out, and unexpected feelings take shape.

releases.title: Maremma
releases.synopsis: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

releases.title: Paris Cafe
releases.synopsis: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

releases.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
releases.synopsis: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

releases.title: Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
releases.synopsis: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

releases.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
releases.synopsis: Carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Prabh's mistakes and carefree nature challenge Aavraj's rigid personality, while secretary Rajdeep becomes the bridge between them. As Prabh learns practicality from Aavraj, Rajdeep discovers joy and emotional freedom through Prabh. With Rajdeep's help, Prabh creates a fictional world to heal the misunderstanding between Aavraj and his estranged daughter. Their reunion restores Aavraj's happiness and brings him emotionally closer to Prabh. Touched by Prabh's spirit, Aavraj finally supports his startup dream, completing their transformative journey.

releases.title: All Pass
releases.synopsis: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

releases.title: Clown Panic
releases.synopsis: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

releases.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
releases.synopsis: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

releases.title: It's a Medical Miracle
releases.synopsis: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

releases.title: Kitti
releases.synopsis: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

releases.title: Chiram
releases.synopsis: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

releases.title: Garuda: Dare to Dream
releases.synopsis: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

releases.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
releases.synopsis: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

releases.title: Free Leonard Peltier
releases.synopsis: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.

releases.title: Vijaynagar'er Hirey
releases.synopsis: When a man embarks on a relaxing trip with his nephew, it quickly turns into a dangerous game of life and death as they find themselves in the middle of a mystery involving a rare diamond.

releases.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
releases.synopsis: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

releases.title: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal
releases.synopsis: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.

releases.title: Dhanushkodiyilekku
releases.synopsis: The starkly different lives of two families intertwine across decades of shifting history. While one group barely survived the catastrophic 1964 Dhanushkodi cyclone, the other has only ever known immense wealth.

releases.title: Only Me
releases.synopsis: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

releases.title: Aarambham Oru Albaniyo Katha
releases.synopsis: Four unemployed graduates from Bethoorpara, North Kerala, face ridicule from family and society. When they finally land a job, it brings unexpected trouble, forcing them into a desperate struggle to escape.

releases.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
releases.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

releases.title: The Room Next Door
releases.synopsis: Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

releases.title: Street Fighter
releases.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

releases.title: Whalefall
releases.synopsis: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

releases.title: Sense and Sensibility
releases.synopsis: Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate and move in with a distant relative, facing romance and money troubles.

releases.title: Sacrifice
releases.synopsis: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

releases.title: You Can See Everything
releases.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

releases.title: Ranabaali
releases.synopsis: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

releases.title: Crawlers
releases.synopsis: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

releases.title: Tenzing
releases.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

releases.title: Masterplan
releases.synopsis: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

releases.title: Money Trap
releases.synopsis: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

releases.title: Friends Sex and Games
releases.synopsis: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

releases.title: Dreamland
releases.synopsis:
Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.

He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

releases.title: Phony
releases.synopsis: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

releases.title: Nayyi Navelli
releases.synopsis: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

releases.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
releases.synopsis: Plot to be announced.

releases.title: Cabaret Boys
releases.synopsis: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

releases.title: You Can't Leave
releases.synopsis: A search for a missing friend turns into a supernatural nightmare. In a dark forest, an abandoned cabin hides an ancient evil. As night falls, friends must survive pursuit, escape the shadows, and uncover the truth before it's too late.

releases.title: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
releases.synopsis: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

releases.title: Prahaar
releases.synopsis: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

releases.title: Relict
releases.synopsis: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

releases.title: When Wine Meets Coffee
releases.synopsis: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

releases.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
releases.synopsis: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

releases.title: Kappi Squad
releases.synopsis: Four emotionally unfinished young adults turn their insecurit ego and wounded pride into an unlikely café business. How will these four go for validation?

releases.title: Her Song
releases.synopsis: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

releases.title: Capturing Bigfoot
releases.synopsis: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

releases.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
releases.synopsis: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

releases.title: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
releases.synopsis: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

releases.title: Hallowarrior
releases.synopsis: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

releases.title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
releases.synopsis: An outsider fueled by relentless determination works his way into the inner circle of the Wu-Tang Clan, where his ambition and creativity converge in the making of an album poised to ignite global controversy.

releases.title: Crazy Kalyanam
releases.synopsis: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

releases.title: Poniiy
releases.synopsis: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

releases.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
releases.synopsis: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

releases.title: Therapy Done Right
releases.synopsis: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

releases.title: A Dessert for Constance
releases.synopsis: Bokolo and Mamadou, sweepers in the city of Paris, are looking for a way to pay for the return home of one of their sick comrades. When they find an old book of recipes in the trash, they discover a passion for French cuisine and decide to participate in a televised cooking competition.

releases.title: Aasha
releases.synopsis: Follows a stubborn, short-tempered widow named Aasha who gets into a tense altercation with a volatile man named Jeemon following a minor road accident.

releases.title: Super Scam Me
releases.synopsis: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

releases.title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
releases.synopsis: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

releases.title: On the Road
releases.synopsis: Veneno, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets Muñeco, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk.

releases.title: Clayface
releases.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

releases.title: Dolly
releases.synopsis: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

releases.title: Possible Love
releases.synopsis: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

releases.title: Nocturne
releases.synopsis: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

releases.title: Wildwood
releases.synopsis: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

releases.title: Wicker
releases.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

releases.title: Fatherland
releases.synopsis: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

releases.title: Klara and the Sun
releases.synopsis: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

releases.title: Udta Teer
releases.synopsis: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

releases.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
releases.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

releases.title: R91
releases.synopsis: The aircraft carrier *Charles de Gaulle* has just set sail for a strategic mission in the Eastern Mediterranean, a region where the situation is volatile. Shortly after departure, however, a female crew member is found dead and another is reported missing. Despite the danger, the operation continues, and a military investigator is urgently dispatched on board. When a new victim is discovered, the *Charles*—a veritable floating city of 1,800 men and 240 women—turns into a trap where a killer, mounting tensions, and unfolding events threaten the crew and perhaps even the country itself.

releases.title: BTS: THE RETURN
releases.synopsis: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

releases.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
releases.synopsis: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

releases.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
releases.synopsis: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

releases.title: Breeder
releases.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

releases.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
releases.synopsis: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

releases.title: A Talent for Murder
releases.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

releases.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
releases.synopsis: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

releases.title: Minimum Wage
releases.synopsis: An overwhelmed group of teenagers struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and their minimum wage salaries. The stakes are low and the pressure is immense.

releases.title: The Mob
releases.synopsis: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

releases.title: Love Language
releases.synopsis: Following a failed engagement, Lou discovers she has a talent for writing other people’s wedding vows. Word spreads across Chicago’s wedding scene and Lou’s services are in high demand. She even has a new admirer in Dash. But everything changes when she’s asked to write vows for Olivia, who’s marrying Warren, Lou’s old college flame.

releases.title: Border Diaries
releases.synopsis: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

releases.title: The Awakening
releases.synopsis: An elite military unit ventures into the South American tropical jungle on a mission to eliminate an enemy target. What begins as a tactical operation quickly turns into a nightmare when they encounter supernatural forces emerging from the depths of the jungle. Five hundred years earlier, a Spanish conquistador expedition was consumed by the same relentless force. Separated by centuries but connected by the same hostile territory, both incursions discover something hidden in the jungle: an ancient presence that cannot be controlled.

releases.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
releases.synopsis: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

releases.title: Delivery Boy
releases.synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

releases.title: Junk
releases.synopsis: A middle-aged filmmaker on the verge of a breakthrough. Two kids in search of a lost backpack. A small dog a long way from home.

releases.title: Magazine
releases.synopsis: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.

releases.title: Closure
releases.synopsis: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

releases.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
releases.synopsis: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

releases.title: The One About Matthew Perry
releases.synopsis: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

releases.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
releases.synopsis: When love becomes an obsession, the line between devotion and danger begins to blur.

releases.title: Little Thomas
releases.synopsis: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

releases.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
releases.synopsis: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

releases.title: You, Me, Us
releases.synopsis: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

releases.title: The Mongoose
releases.synopsis: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

releases.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
releases.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

releases.title: Dead-End Job
releases.synopsis: When a debtor is lured by a strange agency with the promise of lucrative gigs, he is soon thrust into a hellish world of terror and unpredictability.

releases.title: The Remarried Empress
releases.synopsis: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

releases.title: Ramayana
releases.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

releases.title: Gentle Monster
releases.synopsis: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

releases.title: The Perfect Lie
releases.synopsis: The story of two men and women who, the day after their perfect first date, are swept away in an unexpected direction in a storm of truth and lies.

releases.title: The Greatest
releases.synopsis: An intimate exploration of the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

releases.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
releases.synopsis: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

releases.title: Christmas at the Kringles
releases.synopsis: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. But when their son becomes increasingly attached to the unusual family, Mark and Julie begin to suspect that their neighbors aren't quite what they seem.

releases.title: Bass X Machina
releases.synopsis: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

releases.title: #Cult
releases.synopsis: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

releases.title: Queen at Sea
releases.synopsis: Amanda and her stepfather Martin struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda’s mother Leslie, who has dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible – a spouse, a child, an institution – for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control.

releases.title: Silt
releases.synopsis: Hadria, haunted by guilt she cannot explain, is talked into a weekend at an exclusive lakeside sanctuary by her best friend Sierra, and Sierra’s boyfriend Scott. She has never warmed to the hosts, Rick and Anna, but she goes for a shot at something with Mike Warner, a pro athlete sidelined by a knee injury. The property sits behind three locked gates, where hundreds of deer assemble, watching. The lake comes with lore, the kind that makes a good firepit story, and Bartleby, the eccentric owner, tells them it carries the genes of the Gods. Hadria doesn’t buy any of it, right up until the water starts proving Bartleby right.

releases.title: Everest: The Other Side
releases.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

releases.title: The Mosquito Bowl
releases.synopsis: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four US college football stars enlist in the Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

releases.title: Rinnan
releases.synopsis: The series follows the young and ambitious Henry Rinnan, and how his personal demons and narcissistic need for recognition drove him from a failed salesman to Norway’s most notorious traitor.

releases.title: Akka
releases.synopsis: Set in the 1980s matriarchal society of a fictional city of Pernuru, South India, women reign supreme and power has a new name - Akka! Akka is the tale of gangster queens whose matriarchal rule is challenged when an outsider brings an unseen threat, spiralling the all-powerful sisterhood into a chaos storm of violence and survival.

releases.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
releases.synopsis: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

releases.title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
releases.synopsis: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

releases.title: Collision Course
releases.synopsis: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

releases.title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
releases.synopsis: Through intimate interviews with surviving members of its legendary cast and an emotional reunion in Toronto, the film explores the creative partnership that transformed a small Canadian television production into a cultural phenomenon that launched some of comedy’s most celebrated icons.

releases.title: Paging Hezbollah
releases.synopsis: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

releases.title: Anaesthesia
releases.synopsis: A brilliant but disgraced neurosurgeon joins a small-town hospital, where his arrogance clashes with others—but his unconventional methods help save lives.

releases.title: I'm not crazy. Maybe a little...
releases.synopsis: A desperate middle-aged alcoholic and a heartbroken young woman escape from a psychiatric hospital and embark on an absurd journey through the nighttime streets of Riga to save a cat and, perhaps, themselves as well.

releases.title: The Reassured Soul
releases.synopsis: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

releases.title: May Day x 4
releases.synopsis: Drawing on archival footage from four separate film productions that documented the protests of early May, 1970, this short film creates a kaleidoscopic portrait of the response to the New Haven Black Panther trials.

releases.title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
releases.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

releases.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
releases.synopsis: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

releases.title: Desperately Devoted
releases.synopsis: Teri Hatcher reunites with her former on-screen daughter Andrea Bowen and her real-life daughter Emerson Tenney to revisit Desperate Housewives, reflecting on its most memorable storylines, characters and behind-the-scenes moments.

releases.title: Nightblade
releases.synopsis: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

releases.title: A Couple of Lies
releases.synopsis: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.

releases.title: Overacting
releases.synopsis: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

releases.title: Manduka
releases.synopsis: A girl suffering from schizophrenia accidentally meets four criminals. Meanwhile in an hide and seek with Police and the criminals lies the mystery.

releases.title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Robo-Pal
releases.synopsis: Lex Luthor deploys a robo-dog to hunt Superman and Supergirl, but the mission unravels when Krypto and the machine become best friends.

releases.title: Playdate
releases.synopsis: When out-of-work accountant Brian joins stay-at-home dad Jeff for a playdate with their sons, he expects a laid-back afternoon. Instead, they're chased by mercenaries, and Brian—totally unprepared—must survive one absurd obstacle after another.

releases.title: Marie Antoinette
releases.synopsis: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.

releases.title: Raise the Red Lantern
releases.synopsis: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

releases.title: Possible Love
releases.synopsis: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

releases.title: The Cat in the Hat
releases.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

releases.title: Ghost Soldier
releases.synopsis: A weapon systems engineer and former Green Beret protects his Wyoming neighbors against a ruthless corporation threatening their rural community.

releases.title: Wild Horse Nine
releases.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

releases.title: Club Kid
releases.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

releases.title: Campus Drivers
releases.synopsis: Lois has everything going for her: she's been accepted into the prestigious Belrose University alongside her lifelong love, Max. Lane, on the other hand, lives by his own rules. Creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, he is as famous for his devastating smile as for his inability to commit. Their paths were never supposed to cross. Until the night when Lois, heartbroken, shows up on his doorstep. An unexpected cohabitation. Two worlds colliding. And an attraction impossible to ignore. But some encounters change everything… even awakening buried wounds. And when love arrives uninvited, nothing is certain anymore.

releases.title: Madden
releases.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

releases.title: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
releases.synopsis: Hollywood actor and comedian Nora Lum (a.k.a. Awkwafina) is the descendant of restaurant royalty...but she can't cook. Join the star on an inspiring culinary road trip as she learns the craft and attempts to revive her family's beloved Chinese eatery.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

releases.title: Drummer Boy
releases.synopsis: In this epic musical, two brothers are driven onto opposite sides of the American Revolutionary War. With love, loyalty, and family caught in the crossfire, each must decide who he will become, as the fight for freedom turns into a deeply personal battle for forgiveness.

releases.title: The Good Daughter
releases.synopsis: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

releases.title: The Body
releases.synopsis: Sometimes, when you're a Catholic school dance troupe, your latest group initiation goes sideways. Maybe that means your choreographer dropped all the communion wafers on the floor, but for the girls of the coming-of-age drama "The Body", the results are a little more complicated. Their ritual-gone-wrong leads to a mass frenzy that engulfs an entire community.

releases.title: Jimmy
releases.synopsis: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

releases.title: Devils' Crest
releases.synopsis: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

releases.title: Doozie's Doghouse
releases.synopsis: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!

releases.title: Molder Man
releases.synopsis: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

releases.title: Soul Patrol
releases.synopsis: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

releases.title: The Excrement
releases.synopsis: This Documentary follows Detective Jessip as he hunts down Victor Valentine and his poop monster - "THE FILTH BORN"

releases.title: Mouse
releases.synopsis: Callie and Minnie’s relationship is suddenly upended at the start of the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her charismatic best friend, Minnie starts to form a complicated friendship with Callie’s mother.

releases.title: Daffy Season
releases.synopsis: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

releases.title: Being Heumann
releases.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

releases.title: Miracles of the ER
releases.synopsis: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

releases.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
releases.synopsis: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

releases.title: Christmas Pop-Up
releases.synopsis: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

releases.title: Littermates
releases.synopsis: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

releases.title: Never Surrender
releases.synopsis: An ex-soldier and his grandchildren battle against ruthless criminals in a remote village. To survive, they must also confront their fears and regrets.

releases.title: Making Marie Antoinette
releases.synopsis: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

releases.title: Hatah
releases.synopsis: A cat based neo noir thriller

releases.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
releases.synopsis: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

releases.title: Avedon
releases.synopsis: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

releases.title: ChiaroScuro
releases.synopsis: After a body is found in a Roman museum, an art expert must apply his instincts and skills to help police solve a mystery connected to his own past.

releases.title: Moon Walk
releases.synopsis: Moonwalk is a family comedy entertainer starring Prabhudeva, Yogi Babu, Aju Varghese, and Arjun Ashokan. Featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the film marks the high-profile reunion of Rahman and Prabhudeva after 30 years. Moonwalk also serves as Rahman’s acting debut. Designed as a wholesome theatrical experience, the film combines high-energy dance, music, and humor for families, children and audiences of all ages.

releases.title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
releases.synopsis: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

releases.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
releases.synopsis: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

trending.title: MobLand
trending.synopsis: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

trending.title: Lanterns
trending.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

trending.title: Carrie
trending.synopsis: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

trending.title: Matchbox the Movie
trending.synopsis: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

trending.title: Below
trending.synopsis: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

trending.title: East of Eden
trending.synopsis: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

trending.title: LINK CLICK
trending.synopsis: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!
